name: Lawstronaut
description:
Connect Claude to the Lawstronaut MCP — a fast, developer-friendly Model Context Protocol server. Access legislation, regulations, case law, regulatory guidance, enforcement actions, legislative history, and more across 170+ jurisdictions. Built for AI-powered legal research, compliance workflows, and enterprise automation, Lawstronaut delivers continuously updated legal data with comprehensive jurisdictional coverage, so every result is traceable back to its official source.

Plans start at just $15 per user/month. Research, draft, automate compliance, and build legal AI workflows using legal data that stays up to date as the law changes.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lawstronaut to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lawstronaut to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.lawstronaut.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lawstronaut MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lawstronaut lists 15 MCP tools, including list_jurisdictions, list_portals, list_domains, list_subdomains, list_categories, list_subcategories, list_law_types, list_authority_types, list_issuing_authorities, list_documents, get_document_text, and get_markdown.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lawstronaut?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lawstronaut in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.
Lawstronaut requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lawstronaut is developed by Lawstronaut. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
